Plugin: flopwire
  source: /src/flopwire/plugins/claude-code/flopwire
  description: Search past coding-agent transcripts and message live agent sessions: the flopwire MCP tools, the flopwire hook that delivers messages, and a messaging skill. Needs the flopwire binary on PATH and the device agent running.

Skills
  /flopwire:messaging - Coordinate with another live coding-agent session through Flopwire. Use when your work depends on a change another session made (a commit, branch, PR or decision), when a session needs to know something you found, or when you must answer a <flopwire-message>.

Agents
  (none)

Hooks
  • on user_prompt
      runs: flopwire hook || true (timeout: 5000ms)
  • on post_tool
      runs: flopwire hook || true (timeout: 5000ms)
  • on session_start
      runs: flopwire hook || true (timeout: 5000ms)
  • on stop
      runs: flopwire hook || true (timeout: 5000ms)

Rules
  (none)

MCP servers
  • flopwire
      runs: flopwire mcp

Required plugins: (none)

Optional plugins: (none)

Forbidden plugins: (none)
